value.name: searches room for hidden evidence
value.description: Asha, Daniel, and Priya search the room thoroughly for anything important that might have been hidden there.
evidence: They searched it for two hours.
They went through the drawers of the worktable.
They went through the basket of fabric scraps.
They went through the small bookshelf with its old paperbacks and church bulletins and a copy of a Joy of Cooking
They lifted the cushion of the chair by the window.

value.name: Asha makes Daniel watch the search
value.description: Asha deliberately lets Daniel observe her fruitless searching so he can see her persistence and failure.
evidence: She wanted him to see her not finding anything, and to see her keep going.

value.name: Priya opens sewing machine compartment
value.description: Priya, drawing on her childhood familiarity with treadle machines, thinks to inspect the sewing machine's bobbin compartment.
evidence: Priya, who had grown up with one in her grandmother's house, was the one who thought to open the small compartment in the base where the bobbins were kept.

value.name: finds hidden envelope in bobbin compartment
value.description: Inside the sewing machine's bobbin compartment, the group discovers an unmarked envelope concealed behind the bobbins.
evidence: Inside the bobbin compartment, behind the bobbins, folded into eighths, was an envelope.

value.name: uncovers signed codicil
value.description: The envelope contains a typed codicil dated September 12 and signed by Helena Serrano, Rosa Marquez, and Edith Adelman.
evidence: Inside the envelope was a single page, typed, with a date of September 12, and at the bottom, three signatures: Helena Serrano, in her firm round hand; Rosa Marquez, in a small careful script; and Edith Adelman, in a flourish.

value.name: reveals property bequest to Lucia
value.description: The codicil states that 1247 Pemberton Street is to be devised to Lucia Marie Serrano despite the prior will.
evidence: The codicil read, in the dry language of such things, that notwithstanding Article III of the prior will, the real property known as 1247 Pemberton Street, Philadelphia, was to be devised to Lucia Marie Serrano.

value.name: increases Daniel's cash bequest
value.description: The codicil also changes Daniel's inheritance by increasing his cash bequest.
evidence: The cash bequest to Daniel was to be increased by a specifie
